name: previous
source:
.segment "ONE"
a:
alias: lda #1
 rts
 .byte $60,$60
next: nop
.segment "TWO"
b: rts
; asm198x: cycles(a) <= 8
; asm198x: cycles(alias) <= 8
; asm198x: cycles(next) <= 2
; asm198x: cycles(b) <= 6
config:
MEMORY { ROM: start=$8000, size=$100, file=%O, fill=yes; }
SEGMENTS { ONE: load=ROM, type=ro; TWO: load=ROM, type=ro; }
